description: Read raw XRPL ledger-state entries for a ledger. Use marker from a previous response to continue pagination and ledger_index to pin the lookup to a specific ledger. Use this for canonical ledger entries; use n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger for ledger header and transaction-list metadata.

ledger_index.description: Optional ledger index or selector identifying the ledger whose state objects should be returned.
ledger_index.title: Ledger Index

limit.description: Optional maximum number of ledger-state objects to return.
limit.title: Limit

marker.description: Pagination marker returned by a previous response.
marker.title: Marker

name: n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger_data
